name: Mechanorb
descr: A floating clockwork sphere that has telescoping limbs and comes from a realm of machines and metal.

data.motivesAndTactics: Coordinate, (dis)assemble, move orthogonally, speak in binary

features.name: Hive Mind
features.text: The Mechanorb gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each other Mechanorb within Close range.

features.name: Adaptive Tactics
features.text: _Pool._ When the Mechanorb fails an attack roll, add a token to the Mechanorb Pool. All Mechanorbs in the scene gain a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens in the Mechanorb Pool. Clear all tokens when any Mechanorb takes Severe damage or is defeated.
